basic_details.job_title: Coconut Development Board Driver Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 11 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Coconut Development Board (Nariyal Vikas Board), Kochi, is filling 11 Staff Car Driver posts on deputation basis: 7 posts of Driver Grade I and 4 posts of Driver Grade II. Only Staff Car Drivers already working in government, university, research institute, public sector, semi-government, statutory or autonomous organisations can apply. Applications must go through proper channel to the Chief Executive Officer, Coconut Development Board, Kera Bhavan, SRV Road, Kochi – 682 011. They must reach that address within 60 days from the date the advertisement appears in the Employment News.

content_sections.heading: About CDB
content_sections.text: The Coconut Development Board works under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India. Its office is at Kera Bhavan, SRV Road, Kochi – 682 011, Kerala. The vacancy circular is signed by Pramod P Kurian, Secretary of the Board.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Officials who are eligible and willing, and who can be released at once if selected, must send the application in triplicate in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I, the Bio-Data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma attached to the circular). It goes through proper channel, meaning through the applicant's present employer, to this address: Chief Executive Officer, Coconut Development Board, Kera Bhavan, SRV Road, Kochi – 682 011 FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice states that these vacancies are subject to change. Both posts are open to Staff Car Drivers working in Central or State Governments or Universities or recognized research institutes or public sector undertakings or semi-Government or statutory or autonomous organizations. They must also meet the conditions given below for their post. (a)(i) Holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (a)(ii) With 6 years' service on a regular basis in Level 4 (₹25,500-81,100) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and (b) Subject to passing a trade test of appropriate standard specified by the Central Government. (a)(i) Holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (a)(ii) With 9 years' service on a regular basis in Level 2 (₹19,900-63,200) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and (b) Subject to passing a trade test of appropriate standard specified by the Central Government. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The Annexure-I proforma still asks applicants to list their educational qualifications and to say whether they meet the qualifications the post requires. Candidates should check the official notification for the full post-specific eligibility for each post. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding 56 (fifty-six) years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. This limit applies to both posts. An official selected on deputation basis can choose one of two options. The first is to draw his or her existing basic pay plus deputation (duty) allowance. The second is to have pay fixed in the scale of the post in accordance with DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II), dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. The deputation period shall ordinarily not exceed three years. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment, in the same or another organisation or department of the Central Government.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application in triplicate in the Annexure-I proforma, with a passport size colour photograph affixed Attested copies of complete and up-to-date APAR for the last 5 years Integrity Certificate Vigilance Clearance Certificate The Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority, countersigned with seal. It must confirm that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated, and that the applicant's integrity is certified. It must also state either that no major/minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years, or attach a list of such penalties, as the case may be. The CR Dossier in original, or photocopies of the ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years attested on each page by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Govt. of India or above, must be enclosed. For officers already on deputation: the application must be forwarded by the parent cadre or department with Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate For applicants from an organisation that does not follow Central Government pay scales: the latest salary slip issued by the organisation, showing basic pay with scale of pay and rate of increment, dearness pay/interim relief/other allowances (with break-up) and total emoluments A separate sheet, signed by the applicant, if the space in the form for employment details or additional information is not enough

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: For both posts, eligibility is subject to passing a trade test of appropriate standard specified by the Central Government. In the Annexure-I declaration, the applicant accepts that a Selection Committee will assess the information in the Curriculum Vitae, together with the documents on essential qualifications and work experience, at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CDB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies: 7 Driver Grade I and 4 Driver Grade II. One more Driver Grade I vacancy is anticipated on 1.11.2026, and the notice says the vacancies are subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CDB Driver posts?
faq.answer: The complete application must reach the Coconut Development Board, Kochi, within 60 days from the date the advertisement appears in the Employment News. Applications received after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for CDB Driver Grade I and Driver Grade II?
faq.answer: Staff Car Drivers working in Central or State Governments, Universities, recognized research institutes, public sector undertakings, or semi-Government, statutory or autonomous organizations can apply. They must hold an analogous post on a regular basis or have the required regular service, and they are subject to passing a trade test.

faq.question: Q4. What service is required for Driver Grade I and Driver Grade II?
faq.answer: Driver Grade I needs an analogous regular post or 6 years' regular service in Level 4 (₹25,500-81,100). Driver Grade II needs an analogous regular post or 9 years' regular service in Level 2 (₹19,900-63,200), or equivalent in the parent cadre or department.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CDB Driver deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications, for both posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of CDB Driver Grade I and Grade II?
faq.answer: Driver Grade I is in Level 5 of the pay matrix (₹29,200-92,300), and Driver Grade II is in Level 4 (₹25,500-81,100). A selected official can either keep existing basic pay plus deputation (duty) allowance or have pay fixed in the scale of the post under DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II), dated 17.06.2010.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CDB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-I proforma in triplicate through proper channel to the Chief Executive Officer, Coconut Development Board, Kera Bhavan, SRV Road, Kochi – 682 011. Include attested APARs for the last 5 years, the Integrity Certificate and the Vigilance Clearance Certificate.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the deputation period at CDB?
faq.answer: The deputation period shall ordinarily not exceed three years. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a trade test for the CDB Driver posts?
faq.answer: Yes. For both Driver Grade I and Driver Grade II, eligibility is subject to passing a trade test of appropriate standard specified by the Central Government.
